d: A mature adult with a slender build, featuring chestnut brown hair styled in a short, smooth bob with a side parting. The eyes are a pale, muted blue with a pensive expression, set within a face rendered in a fragmented, cubist art style. The attire consists of a white sleeveless dress over a white collared shirt, accented by a mustard yellow necktie and small gold studs. Signature details include a light blue wide-brimmed hat adorned with a long white feather, and gold-rimmed spectacles resting on the nose.
